alerts.title: Viral load monitoring interval due for review
alerts.message: Guideline states that patients on two NRTIs plus DTG should have viral load checked every 6 months, with 12-monthly testing possible only after VL below 50 copies/mL for over one year with reliable adherence. The patient's last viral load was 40 copies/mL on 2025-10-01 (113 days before this visit), which is suppressed, and adherence is reported as good. No next viral load date is recorded in the plan, so the scheduled 6-month test should be confirmed.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm the next viral load is scheduled about 6 months after 2025-10-01 (around April 2026). Extend to 12-monthly only if VL has been below 50 copies/mL for over one year with reliable adherence.
